thread:
alex: Drafting the release notes + internal announce for v1.4.2. Quick ask — who should be in the internal audience?

mona: Prod eng, support on standby, sales for the account-impact line, and docs for the changelog snippet.

jordan: Add legal (EU privacy) only if we surface telemetry/opt-in changes. I can ping them if we need a blurb.

alex: Good call. Proposed short blurb for the internal message — please iterate: 
```
Release v1.4.2 (staging -> prod):
- Serving runtime: reduce cold-starts for small-batch inference
- Router: fallback to quantized variant when GPU capacity spikes
- Console: per-route latency breakdown in beta

Canary schedule: 15:40 PT (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Oncall: sasha.
Rollback: if 95th pct latency increases > 200ms vs baseline or error-rate > 1% for 10m.
```

sasha: Love the blurb. For pinning: we'll pin model image redwood/serve:v1.4.2 to shard-03 and set fallback to v1.4.1. Config snippet I will push to the deploy job: `routes:/api-gen: pin: v1.4.2; fallback: v1.4.1`

mona: For internal announce timing, let's target 15:35 PT to give the oncall 5 mins pre-warning. I'll handle the calendar blurb and the support thread template.

jordan: Legal said they only need to review if we change data collection. Nothing to do here.

alex: I'll assemble the internal DM with microcopy + link to staged rn. Draft tidy version below, please thumbs: 
"Short: v1.4.2 rolling out 15:40 PT. Key improvements: cold-start, graceful fallback. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Oncall: sasha. Rollback criteria included. See full notes: <staging-notes-link>"

devops-bot: Deploy queued by alex — https://deploy.redwood.com/jobs/abc123 (canary plan attached).

sasha: Oncall: I'll be at my desk. If canary shows CPU jitter > 30% or 95p latency delta > 200ms, I'll trigger rollback. Ping me in #eng-oncall.

mona: I'll post the internal announce at 15:35 PT and add the support template. alex — can you pin the release snippet in the channel once it's live?

alex: Yep. I'll post and pin a shorthand and link the detailed notes + rollback playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/rollback-v1.4.json

mona: :thumbsup:  Good to go.

devops-bot: Deploy started — canary phase 5% (15:40 PT). Monitor: latency, errors, GPU mem pressure.

alex: Thanks everyone — will post pinned announce and notify stakeholders when canary passes 25%.
